text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a review article as indicated in the title and text. It synthesizes existing knowledge on how land-use modelling tools can inform bioenergy policies, with an emphasis on land-use change (LUC), including direct and indirect LUC, and discusses modelling approaches, data issues, and policy implications. Although it does not present new primary LULC prediction modeling with national-scale spatial implementation, it critically evaluates existing land-use change models and data relevant to bioenergy scenarios, thus fitting the definition of a review that touches on LULC future prediction. It is not excluded because it focuses on land-use change in the context of bioenergy, which involves LULC future scenarios, and it is not primarily a biomass/carbon study without LULC analysis. Therefore, it meets the criteria for REVIEW.)
